world: Phosphor console. A single plane, lit by an electron beam. Alignment does the work boxes would do elsewhere, and brightness is the only depth axis.
antiReference: The previous build of this site: indigo accent, system serif, centred single column, a hairline rule under every section. Client called it vibe-coded.
colorScheme: dark-only (no light palette exists; color-scheme: dark is declared)

phosphor.role: The only depth axis. Dim recedes, rest is body and internal links, bright is headings, hot is internal-link excitation.

amber.role: Semantic: leaves the record. Scoped to a[href^="http"], source attributions, date stamps, the mark. Never emphasis, never an internal link.

contrastMeasured.note: phos-dim at 6.2:1 is the darkest text value permitted in this system.

elevation.rule: No shadows, blur, layering, or z-index above the skip link. Depth is brightness only.

motion.rule: Fast excitation, slow decay. The only animation in the system; a second one is a violation.
motion.appliedTo: Internal link colour (phos -> phos-hot), outbound link colour (amber -> amber-bright), and log row hover (background lift plus title and date excitation).

breakpoints.behaviour: Grid collapses to one column; stamp goes inline above its title; body drops to 0.9375rem and padding to 0.9rem, giving 39.8ch. Narrow-viewport rules are declared LAST in the stylesheet because they override base rules of equal specificity.

grid.rule: Column 1 is the stamp rail (dates, categories, status only). Column 2 is the record (all prose). The log spans 1 / -1.

typeface.why: A monospace drawn for reading rather than for code. The console world requires mono; a coding face would have made the long-form unreadable.
typeface.note: Mono here is world-native, not a technical costume: rail alignment, tabular stamps and log columns depend on a fixed advance width.

rules: No cards, panels, boxes, shadows, gradients, or border radii in the interface.
One typeface. Never fall back to a system stack.
Amber is semantic (points elsewhere); green is the record. Never swap them.
Hairlines appear in exactly three places: under the status bar, between log entries, above the record footer.
More space above a heading than below it (3.5rem / 1.25rem).
Stamps are baseline-matched to the heading they label.
Icons: authored SVG, 24px grid, stroke-width 2, round caps/joins, currentColor.

Internal links are phos with an underline, exciting to phos-hot. Outbound links are amber. Never give an internal link phos-bright — that is the heading value and the collision removes the only colour channel separating them.

field-label.note: Content-coupled. Renders the post format's **What happened.** / **Why it matters.** convention as record fields without editing markdown. Paired with the authoring contract in CLAUDE.md.

notCanonized: The field-label rule is recorded but flagged content-coupled: it depends on the post format guaranteeing **Label.** as a paragraph's first child, so it is a shared convention with CLAUDE.md rather than a free-standing style.

seed.note: Roll ran and reproduces; overridden by a user-pinned phosphor terminal, which the playbook permits.
